description: This Java source file defines the StoreFilter class, which extends Spring's HandlerInterceptorAdapter. It implements a preHandle method that processes HTTP requests for a web shop, managing session attributes, cookies, breadcrumbs, cache retrieval, and dynamic content for store pages. The class handles functionalities such as detecting store codes, managing customer and anonymous customer info, setting locale and language, loading content, categories, configurations, and setting up breadcrumbs and page metadata.

classes.name: StoreFilter
classes.description: A Spring MVC interceptor that processes incoming HTTP requests, manages store and user session data, loads content and configurations, and sets up page metadata and breadcrumbs for an online shop.

methods.name: preHandle
methods.description: Main method called before request handling, responsible for initializing session data, handling store code switching, loading content, categories, configurations, and setting metadata for the page.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Loads configuration settings for the current store, using cache to improve performance.

methods.name: getContentPageNames
methods.description: Retrieves names and URLs for CMS page contents based on store and language.

methods.name: getContentObjects
methods.description: Retrieves Content objects for building site sections, with caching support.

methods.name: getTopCategories
methods.description: Fetches the top-level categories for display in the store front.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve categories associated with the store.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Helper method to get Content entities for the site.

methods.name: getContentPagesNames
methods.description: Gets map of content page descriptions by store and language.

methods.name: setBreadcrumb
methods.description: Sets up breadcrumb navigation items for the current page based on content and categories.

methods.name: setMerchantStoreInSession
methods.description: Retrieves a store by code from the database and sets it in the session.
